name: 61364 · Streator, IL
findings: ZIP 61364 (Streator) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61364 (Streator) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 61364 (Streator) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
